metadata.description: Cadly: parametric CAD for 3D-printable parts. The plugin connects agents to Cadly's MCP server and teaches them to model printable parts.

plugins.name: cadly
plugins.description: Design 3D-printable parts in Cadly from Claude: sketch, extrude, fillet, drill, combine, change parameters and export a checked STL or STEP through Cadly's MCP server.
